site_location.title: Site location (empty)
site_location.x-seam-help: gps, starting empty: click the map to drop a marker, or press the location button to use the browser's position. Drag the marker to refine it. The field posts lat,lng with six decimals, and typing coordinates by hand moves the marker.

depot_location.title: Depot location (preset)
depot_location.x-seam-help: The same widget opened on a stored value: the map centres on it and the marker is already in place.

yard_location.title: Yard location (wide panel)
yard_location.x-seam-help: x-seam-panel: wide. The map opens at the full width of the field, in the page flow, like the icon-picker's grid. Every gps field has the expand button (top right of the panel) to switch between the two modes.

ean13_code.title: EAN-13 barcode
ean13_code.x-seam-help: barcode with the default symbology (EAN13). The vector preview redraws as you type, and the field turns red while the value is not valid for the symbology.

ean8_code.title: EAN-8 barcode
ean8_code.x-seam-help: x-seam-barcode-format: EAN8 (seven digits plus the check digit).

upc_code.title: UPC-A barcode
upc_code.x-seam-help: x-seam-barcode-format: UPC (eleven digits plus the check digit).

handover_signature.title: Handover signature
handover_signature.x-seam-help: signature: draw with the mouse or a finger. The stroke is serialised as a data:image/png;base64 string, so the echo page shows it as one long value. Clear wipes the canvas.

photos.title: Photos
photos.x-seam-help: image: a drag-and-drop gallery stored in /blob. It needs a saved record to attach the pictures to, so on this demo page (which saves nothing) it shows the create-mode message; on an edit form it is the full uploader.
